description: This file contains a Swift actor 'TestIsolationLock' and an enum 'TestIsolation' for managing test environment state isolation during testing, including environment variables and user defaults. It provides mechanisms for acquiring and releasing a lock, as well as executing code in an isolated environment with specific environment variables and defaults.

classes.name: TestIsolationLock
classes.description: An actor implementing a lock mechanism to synchronize test environment setup and teardown.

methods.name: acquire
methods.description: Asynchronously acquires the lock. If not locked, set lock; otherwise, wait until it is available.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases the lock and resumes the next waiting continuation if any.

methods.name: withIsolatedState
methods.description: Runs a suspendable block of code with specified environment variables and user defaults, restoring previous state afterward.

methods.name: withEnvValues
methods.description: Runs a suspendable block with provided environment variables, restoring previous environment after execution.

methods.name: withUserDefaultsValues
methods.description: Runs a suspendable block with provided user defaults, restoring previous defaults after execution.

methods.name: tempConfigPath
methods.description: Generates and returns a temporary file path for test configuration.
